pages.text: The river rose, covering three washing steps. All three children sat together on the highest step.
Mina wanted three towels in a row on the line. "Let's see whose is whitest!"
Sonu squeezed and rubbed their towel. Only a few bubbles formed.
Mina took it from Sonu's hands. "I'll wash it for you."
Raju had already hung a towel. Mina quickly hung two more. Sonu sat empty-handed.
Sonu took their towel off the line. "I wanted to wash it myself!"
Only two towels hung there. The middle was empty.
Mom put the soap back in Sonu's hand.
Sonu rubbed the towel. Beside them, Mina poured water gently.
Three towels hung side by side. Drops fell. Drip, drip.
